headline: Forum Energy Technologies Beats Third-Quarter Earnings and Revenue Forecasts
summary: Forum Energy Technologies reported quarterly earnings that surpassed analyst estimates by $0.29 per share, alongside higher-than-expected revenue.
why: Forum Energy Technologies manufactures specialized equipment for the global oil, natural gas, and renewable energy sectors.

impacts.name: Forum Energy Technologies
impacts.why: Outperforming quarterly consensus earnings and revenue benchmarks generally enhances equity valuations.
